title: Elimination produces triangular pivots
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set of variables, let $c_1,\ldots,c_k$ be an ordered list of variables in $V$, and let a finite list of linear equations over $\mathbb F_2$ in the variables $V$ be given. Applying the specified row elimination procedure to these variables and equations produces pivots that are triangular: each pivot equation has coefficient $1$ on its pivot variable, every later pivot equation has coefficient $0$ on that earlier pivot variable, and these properties hold at every position in the pivot list.
hypotheses_covered: An ordered list of variables is supplied
A list of linear equations over $\mathbb F_2$ is supplied
